content.value: To find the elevation of the top (A) of the minar of KUET mosque, observations were made from two stations P and R, 50 m apart. The horizontal angel measured at P between R and the top of the minar was 60º 45' and that measured at R between the. top of the minar and P station was 72º 30'. The angel of elevation of the top of the minar was measured to be 20º 17' at R and that was 20º 48' at P. Stadia readings on. B.M. When the instrument was at P = 2.969 m and that with the instrument at R = 3.073 m. Calculate the elevation of the minar of KUET mosque if that B.M. was 420m.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
